title: Specify component-meta.yaml
description: Validates the structure of `components/component-meta.yaml` in the out-of-tree per-project cache — the component mirror's provenance stamp, the structural twin of `codex/codex-meta.yaml`. Written whenever the component cache is populated or refreshed; read by the CLI to decide whether the cache is populated.

source.description: The adapter source value the mirror was populated from (a `file://` component URI).

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp (UTC) of when the mirror was written.
